**Key findings (2026-08-07):**

1. **`estudios-preparacion.json` — the demo overrides global with a stale schema.**
   `packs/example-town/` carries its own 30-entry file using the legacy
   `preparacion` field; global's 47-entry file uses the structured
   `antes/avisar/despues/no_hace_falta/resumen` schema. Whole-file override means
   the demo never sees global's version: prep pages render via `prep_model.antes()`'s
   legacy fallback and silently drop the summary/avisar/después sections the prod
   site shows. Fix: restructure example-town's file to the new schema (or drop it
   and inherit global's, if the id overlap allows).
2. **The demo chain has no country level.** `global,example-town` skips L2/L3, so
   `country.json`, `endpoints.json`, `msd-institutions.json`, `trusted-domains.json`
   don't resolve — format.py/js fall back to hardcoded AR literals. Works today,
   but the demo never exercises the pack-driven path.
3. **Demo `medicos.json` items lack `entrevista_habilitada`** (also `fuente_nombre`,
   `rol`) — the demo can't showcase per-doctor intake-interview enablement.
4. **Demo center pages are thin**: `centros-info.json` items use old `credit` and
   lack `facts`/`more`/`sources`/`photo_credit`; no `centros-galeria.json`,
   `centros-resenas.json`, `clinicas.json`, `photos.json`, sprites, or `centers/`
   (L5) pack in the demo chain.
5. **Wiki (`conocimiento.json`): demo composes 3 articles vs prod 23.** Not empty,
   but thin.
6. Reverse direction: only `apertura_mismo_dia` (same-day opening) exists demo-only
   in `servicios.json` (3 items) — prod never exercises that flow; and demo-only
   `fotos-medicos/` dir (prod uses `medico-photos/`/`doctor-photos/` names).
